scope: Physical iOS comparison of initial versus optimized Skia 3.0.6 / WebGPU 0.12.1; same video library, not historical Skia 2 or Skia 3.0.3.

sourceQualification.kind: Frozen executable and Hermes bundle identities checked against the planned apps and each completed execution journal; no retrospective global source fingerprint is invented.

collection.settledMeaning: Scheduled stabilization interval after owner cleanup; not a measurement of complete driver/cache release or an external GPU fence.

userReportedContext.interpretation: External heat and background network activity were not quantified. Device warmth cannot be attributed to the library, and the cause of timing differences is not isolated. Raw observations and nominal qualification remain unchanged.

notes: All selected runs were fair: descriptive warm-condition measurements only.
Pixels and requested standalone catalogue media validators remain unavailable; exact probed output metadata is retained separately.
Six repetitions per variant come from two processes, not six independent process starts.
No physical Android execution or Android performance conclusion.
